'''HoHoHo2''' is inspired by the map Hohoho.bsp - a christmas season themed map for FFA. This map has a similar setting in a house with a christmas tree. 
* [[Red Armor]] is placed in the chimney, you need to drop down from rooftop through the chimney into to the fireplace to pick up the armor.
